name: labs/kist-csrc__batchsynthesismodule
title: IKA RET control-visc hotplate stirrer
intro: IKA RET control-visc hotplate stirrer, adapted from kist-csrc/batchsynthesismodule. It reads `medium_temperature`, `hot_plate_temperature`, `heat_transfer_medium_setpoint`, `hot_plate_safety_setpoint` and 3 more; sets `medium_setpoint`, `hot_plate_setpoint` and `stir_rate_setpoint`; runs `heat_to`, `set_heater`, `set_stirrer`, `set_ph_meter` and 3 more. `heat_to`: set the target temperature of a thermal zone and optionally wait for the zone to reach the setpoint within a declared tolerance. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
